Priya Rao: Heads up everyone 1 Tanya's turning 30 next Friday (May 12). Thinking a hybrid surprise for NYC + remote. Ideas? :tada:
Alex Kim: Vegan cake at the office + care packages for remote? :cake::package:
Jordan Lee: Succulent desk plant? Shes into plants.
Mei Chen: I can host a 15-min Zoom drop-in at 3pm ET. We could do a quick montage and some jokes. I can stitch clips if people send short videos. :movie_camera:
Priyanka Singh: I'll gather shipping addresses and dietary needs. DM me addresses by Wednesday.
Priya Rao: Tanya is vegan, so cake should be vegan. Alex, any bakery recs near 5th Ave?
Alex Kim: GreenSlice on 44th does vegan tiered cakes. I can pick it up at 2:45pm.
Jordan Lee: I'll assemble a montage. Please send 1020s clips with a memory or wish. Deadline: Wed EOD.
Mei Chen: I'll set up the calendar invite and run the surprise screen share.
Priyanka Singh: For APAC folks, shipping might be slow  maybe gift cards?
Alex Kim: Yep, local vouchers for APAC, donut boxes for EMEA.
Priya Rao: Also a signed card (digital + physical). Who can take photos in person?
Alex Kim: I can take photos.
BirthdayBot: Reminder created: "Tanya 30th surprise" on 2025-05-12 14:45 ET.
Priya Rao: @here react with :thumbsup: if you can join the surprise at 3pm ET, or :wave: if you'll send a clip but can't be there live.
Alex Kim: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Mei Chen: :thumbsup:
Priyanka Singh: :wave: (will send a clip)
Priya Rao: Logistics checklist: Alex picks up vegan cake, Mei runs Zoom, Jordan compiles montage, Priyanka handles shipping. Sheet for uploads and addresses coming in DM. Thanks all! :party_popper:
